senses.definition: produced by crossbreeding
(genetics) an organism that is the offspring of genetically dissimilar parents or stock; especially offspring produced by breeding plants or animals of different varieties or breeds or species
examples: a mule is a cross between a horse and a donkey

senses.definition: a car which runs on two power sources, usually an internal combustion engine and an electronic motor
a composite of mixed origin
examples: the vice-presidency is a hybrid of administrative and legislative offices

senses.definition: a word that is composed of parts from different languages (e.g., ‘monolingual’ has a Greek prefix and a Latin root)
a condition promoting sanitary practices
the science concerned with the prevention of illness and maintenance of health
extravagant exaggeration
a punctuation mark (‘-’) used between parts of a compound word or between the syllables of a word when the word is divided at the end of a line of text
divide or connect with a hyphen
the use of hypnosis in psychotherapy
an expression of agreement that is not supported by real conviction
insincerity by virtue of pretending to have qualities or beliefs that you do not really have
a person who professes beliefs and opinions that he or she does not hold in order to conceal his or her real feelings or motives
professing feelings or virtues one does not have
in a hypocritical manner
examples: he behaved hypocritically by praying piously when people were watching

senses.definition: a message expressing an opinion based on incomplete evidence
a proposal intended to explain certain facts or observations
a tentative insight into the natural world; a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena
examples: a scientific hypothesis that survives experimental testing becomes a scientific theory
he proposed a fresh theory of alkalis that later was accepted in chemical practices

senses.definition: to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds
examples: Scientists supposed that large dinosaurs lived in swamps

senses.definition: based primarily on surmise rather than adequate evidence
examples: theories about the extinction of dinosaurs are still highly conjectural
the supposed reason for his absence

senses.definition: a hypothetical possibility, circumstance, statement, proposal, situation, etc.
examples: consider the following, just as a hypothetical possibility

senses.definition: excessive or uncontrollable fear
neurotic disorder characterized by violent emotional outbreaks and disturbances of sensory and motor functions
state of violent mental agitation
characterized by or arising from psychoneurotic hysteria
examples: during hysterical conditions various functions of the human body are disordered

senses.definition: marked by excessive or uncontrollable emotion
in a hysterical manner
examples: she screamed hysterically when she heard the news
